liveObservations.detail: Back had no destination when browser refresh removed navigation history. Fallback added; live retest pending.

liveObservations.detail: Refreshing the creator then tapping Back now reaches Settings.

liveObservations.scenario: Assign list and schedule calendar handoff
liveObservations.detail: Kitchen assignment to Blake appears and database confirms it. New shopping trip selected Nov 27 at 7:30 PM and appears with that time in Group calendar.

liveObservations.scenario: Corrected reorder, peer sync and both reloads
liveObservations.detail: Pinned Food Staples first; moved Kitchen above Room; Sponges above Dish soap. Blake receives same order; both sessions retain it after reload.
